title: Label and RichTextLabel: Fix updating `visible_*` when text changes.

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Label: Always recalculate visible_characters (from visible_ratio) when text changes. (Previously, it did not change visible_chars when visible_ratio >= 1.0, resulting in invalid state.)

RichTextLabel: Recalculate visible_ratio (from visible_characters) when text changes. (Previously, it did not update at all.) This is intentionally different to Label for backwards compatibility.

Other misc related changes:

- When computing visible_ratio from visible_characters, clamp the value between 0.0 and 1.0 (matching the behaviour of the visible_ratio setter). This does not affect the text rendering.
- RichTextLabel: When computing visible_ratio from visible_characters, if text length is zero, set visible_ratio to 1.0 rather than leaving unchanged (consistent with Label).

Added a full test suite covering the above changes.

I kept (as close as possible) the discrepancy between `Label` and `RichTextLabel` discussed in #119840 (and explcitly tested this difference in the test suite). It can easily be modified for consistency but I wanted to make minimal breaking changes with this PR.

Since this is fixing a long-standing non-regression bug, I assume we'll wait until 4.7 is out and try to get this into 4.8.
